ios.desc:
MapDex is the platform for interactive maps.

Pin the places that matter, add the details behind them, and share a map others can explore. Use it for your travels, a local guide, recommendations for an audience, or places tied to a project or event.

Follow people you trust and discover new spots through their maps. React, comment, and connect right on the map around each place.

With MapDex, you can:

• Create and share interactive maps
• Pin places you’ve visited, loved, or want to explore
• Build a personal map of your world
• Curate local guides and recommendations
• Follow friends and explore their maps
• Engage with places through reactions and comments
• Add stories and context to every pin

Your places. Your map. Your story.

android.desc:
MapDex is the social map for travelers.

MapDex lets you build a living map of everywhere you've been and follow the people you trust to discover everywhere you should go next. Every pin is a real experience, from a real person, with a real rating and story behind it.

Explore the world through people:
• Follow friends and see their travel maps in real time
• Tap into any pin to see photos, ratings, and personal takes from travelers who've actually been there
• Pin your own places and share your experiences with your community
• Build a bucket list inspired by the people around you
• Create a travel identity that reflects who you actually are

MapDex is built on the idea that the best travel recommendations come from real experiences, shared by real people. Honest takes from a global community of travelers who've been there and want to tell you about it.

Whether you're a weekend explorer or a backpacker, MapDex turns your travels into something personal, visual, and genuinely social.

quotes.text:
MapDex is a social map for travelers.

Users can track places they've visited, save destinations to their bucket list, and explore maps from friends and other travelers.

One thing I felt was missing from existing products was meaningful ranking. Instead of relying on a traditional 5-star system where ratings tend to become inflated, MapDex lets users rank destinations against others within the same category. Cities are ranked against cities, beaches against beaches, countries against countries, and so on.

The goal is to create a more useful way to discover places through people you trust while building a visual record of where you've been and where you want to go next.

The app is currently live on iOS and Android. I'd love feedback on the product, ranking system, positioning, and growth strategy.

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/mapdex/id6762475774

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mapdex.app
